title: SpaceX has landed rocket boosters over 600 times and it still looks fake

How SpaceX lands a rocket booster back on Earth after reaching space
The moment a SpaceX rocket falls from space and catches itself on a tiny pad
Why a SpaceX rocket booster does not crash when it comes back down
caption:
SpaceX's rocket boosters fall from the edge of space at over 2,000 km/h, fire their engines for a few seconds, and land on a pad within meters of the target, every single time.

The booster that goes up is the same one that comes back down. SpaceX reuses them flight after flight, which is how a single rocket can fly dozens of times. That is what keeps the cost low enough to actually run a space business.

SpaceX has now pulled this off more than 600 times. No other rocket company on Earth has done it once.
